decision.basis: The experiment reduces allocated bytes in all nine measured configurations, but retains an extra current project text/hash set across requests. For the large profile with all files edited, the candidate recorded additional Gen2 collections. That unresolved memory/collection tradeoff is not accepted for production promotion.

large_all_files_edited_observation.interpretation: Observed in one fresh process per arm for this configuration. It does not establish a universal regression, a causal resident-memory explanation, or any latency/RSS difference. All raw GC samples are retained without filtering.

decision.future_scope: Weak or existing-owner-only cross-request memoization remains a separate future experiment. A separate request-only variant has separate source/proofs; none of these allocation numbers are relabeled as its results.

scope: Actual file reads plus source capture, standard decoded-text UTF8 hashes, fingerprint and complete manifest preparation. Candidate retains exact decoded texts and their hashes across requests, reusing only after full decoded EOF equality; the old baseline rereads/constructs strings and hashes independently for fingerprint and manifest.
limits: All clocks permanently unaccepted. No compile-time, time-to-play, source IO latency, peak RSS or Unity/Unreal claim.
This projection always generates a manifest. It does not establish a win for cached validation-only/no-write paths or full compiler allocation totals.
No Roslyn parsing, analyzer task, emit or ProjectCompiler.Compile runs occur inside allocation counters. Synthetic PE/PDB bytes are only manifest inputs; publication trust is a separate quality gate.
The common Work wrapper/indexed hash-observation plumbing is projection overhead. Full outputs remain live until validation, equally in both arms.

Previous observer references are weak. Candidate owner alone retains the real current text/hash set; the baseline has no manufactured strong source cache. This does not model all existing Roslyn working-state lifetimes.
One fresh process per arm/configuration, arm order alternates across nine configurations; no within-configuration reversed-pair confirmation or repeated independent process pairs.
No universal GC or performance guarantee follows from allocation reductions or the additional observed collections.

configuration.fixture: ASCII C# sources with comment filler. Each selected file changes one literal near its beginning on every producer pass. 100% means all files edited, not full-content replacement.
configuration.counter: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(precise:true), process wide around source read/capture/hash/fingerprint/manifest preparation.
configuration.excluded_from_counter: Corpus/tool-hash initialization, producer writes, explicit generation2 GC, independent old-algorithm oracle reads/hashes, complete comparisons, weak reference observation and output.
configuration.same_paths_across_arms: Each configuration uses the same corpus path, reset before each arm, allowing fingerprint/manifest/source-hash-vector digest equality across fresh processes.
configuration.reference_observation: Weak text/hash/capture observations; clear actual/oracle result and hash slots before each pre-pass GC. Candidate reuses count-minus-edited references after warmup; baseline 0. Capture identity reused only with 0% edits.

actual_candidate_quality.scope: Actual same-assembly candidate built from copied source closure with new capture/partial files; no prebuilt old CompileServer self-reference. Tests include existing open/error behavior, restoredmtime and encoding-only equality, ownership failure pruning/Retain, independent same-tool full bytes, actual cached publications, PDB/manifest fallback, dependent failure/repair, existing wire/trust and validation-only output preservation.
actual_candidate_quality.SDK_runtime_complete_manifest_reference: The immutable quality report contains the complete before/after SDK/runtime/packs hash maps; all matched.

allocation_app_verification.scope: One console-only build against the immutable 110-quality candidate DLL closure; no candidate rebuild. One miniVerify: 100 sources, 0/1/100% edits, both arms, three steps. No measured allocation cells.

source_and_binary_bindings.linked_Host_boundary: Protocol.cs, PublishedSnapshot.cs, PublishedReadOnly.cs and Host project were unchanged. New typed partial exists only in CompileServer; original shared Host/wire/trust APIs remain unchanged.
source_and_binary_bindings.opaque_capture: Private Capture constructor; full-reading factory derives/reuses hashes itself; owned read-only rows and private lookup. No caller-supplied hash factory. Separate from mutable Roslyn Entry and publication authority.
source_and_binary_bindings.retention: One current observed source/hash capture per active output, ownership pruning and no predecessor chain; still a new resident text/hash set for valid disk-cache sessions that never Generate. No retained-byte/RSS measurement was made.

raw_proof.complete_frozen_before_after_manifest: The allocation report retains source/props/app/reference/actual runtime file hashes before/after. frozen_unchanged=true. No retry, rebuild, added cell or mid-window source change.
